description: Manually enroll a contact in an active automation. The automation must be in 'active' status. Use send_event for event-driven enrollment. Confirm with the user first: the automation can start emailing the contact straight away.

apiKey.description: Send16 API key (overrides SEND16_API_KEY env var)

contactId.description: Contact UUID (use search_contacts to look up by email first)

name: enroll_in_automation
title: Enroll contact in automation
